evidenceMethod.currentKeySource: Exported production selectChecks from core4/tools/validate-diff.js.168 existing owner-trigger file paths used only as read-only inventory selection inputs, not asserted changes;71registered checks selected, none missing.
evidenceMethod.keyFormula: hash({check, command, dependencies: sorted expanded unique [relativePath,sha256(bytes)], projections:[{dependency,digest}]}); hash/canonical from protocol/json.js
evidenceMethod.evidenceSearch: Direct top-level checks[]/selectedChecks[] with check+evidenceKey in all parsed docs/evidence JSON. Explicit result/outcome PASS required; B1 complete accepted batch or B2 single-check complete document adapters retained only as documented authority.
evidenceMethod.nonAuthority: Progress, audit/remaining-acceptance and pending manifests are excluded. Cancelled/partial/rejected records never independently accepted. Accepted consolidated B6 may authorize its documented exact-key reuse of completed prefixes.
evidenceMethod.counts: Per-check caseCount is recorded evidence; shared batch counts are marked and never allocated twice. Inventory totals do not certify release.
evidenceMethod.parentByteCommandBoundDecisionRu: Исторические две byte-command группы после map/test changes неприменимы; переведены в current-unverified и включены в composite16.

evidencePolicyRu: Текущий key = check ID + штатная command + все dependency bytes + projections. Recorded exact reuse требует accepted PASS, не audit/progress/partial result.
Byte-command reuse отмечен отдельно: recordedEvidenceKey=null; accepted named batch и полный снимок команд/closure обязательны.
Подходящее evidence не найдено означает needs-current-evidence, не FAIL и не доказательство отсутствия прежних запусков.
Source/TEMP, installed native observations, Windows/другие ОС и product acceptance не взаимозаменяемы.
Нельзя суммировать named check case counts как глобальное unique total; shared group9 относится к двум ID один раз.
Пауза, evidence disposition и future execution ортогональны. Manifest и command arrays не запускают проверки и не дают live authority.
